negative_predecessors.disposition: ST3 NO_GO; delayed-credit ablation null and interference retention 0%

north_star: Independent tokenless/native non-transformer causal cognition with persistent knowledge and low compute. In-house simulation is development evidence only.
hypothesis: Balanced interventions independently varied before identical current public states and actions expose learnable delayed causal effects. A new native causally indexed memory may demonstrate improved unfamiliar-law predictions and cold retention versus strong same-information matched lag-aware conventional controls.

source.law: Private law_id sets rotation 1+SHA256(utf8('ST4-rot|'+law_id))[0]%3; action 0 or 1 applies immediate XOR SHA256(utf8('ST4-mask|'+law_id+'|'+action))[0]; action 2 schedules delayed XOR SHA256(utf8('ST4-delay|'+law_id))[0] for NEXT step only and no immediate action mask; action 3 no-op. Each step x_next = ROTL8(x,r) XOR immediate(action) XOR pending; pending_next=delay_mask iff action 2 else 0.
source.paired_trials: For each seed/trial, independently reset both arms to public x0=SHA256(utf8('ST4-state|'+seed+'|'+trial))[0] with empty pending. First actual action differs: 2 in treatment arm, 3 in control arm. Public x1 must be identical. Second actual action is the SAME one of 0,1,3 in both arms, chosen by SHA256(utf8('ST4-actor|'+seed+'|'+trial))[0]%3, mapping 0->0,1->1,2->3. Arm execution order is digest byte[1]%2, independent of law and model. Final public effects can differ ONLY because first intervention scheduled a hidden delayed effect. Both arms each take two real original source steps; no fabricated labels.
source.model_public_interface: 8 public current bits, announced action 0..3, previous observed public outcome bits and previous announced action ONLY; no law ID, mask, hidden pending, source seed, actor entropy, trial ID, branch ID, reward or source oracle.

stage0_source_only.before: Before model fitting or held-development source exposure, audit TRAIN laws/seeds only: every paired trial must have same pre-probe public x and same probe action in both arms, and authentic public post-probe changes must differ in >=95% of paired trials per training law; at least 1500 pairs; all three blinded probe actions >=100 pair trials; both arm orders nonzero. No source-law or pending leakage; exact source action SHA stable across Windows and Linux.
stage0_source_only.fail: SOURCE_COUNTERFACTUAL_IDENTIFIABILITY_NO_GO, preserve immutable negative, no law/seed/threshold retuning.

mechanism: New eight-cell native integer intervention-conditioned causal hypothesis and durable profile retrieval, source only public bits and actions; distinct from ST1 topology, ST2 appearance cache and ST3 deterministic actor confound. Model implementation and controls frozen before held outcomes.
controls: Fully trained same-public-input 45-weight eight-state conventional recurrent with lagged action input
Fully trained same-learned-byte-budget lag-aware contextual count with previous action and current bits
Private source oracle for headroom diagnostic ONLY
metric: Original preaction eight-bit Brier per unseen law, pooled and intervention-probe slice; source action-consequence SHA and paired contrast; cold retention after eight unrelated laws, interference, exact integer cross-OS checkpoint, CPU/wall/RSS/bytes whole-process cost.
frozen_dev_go: Candidate beats both fully trained matched controls by >=0.02 absolute pooled Brier and on >=3 of 4 held DEV laws
Candidate beats both causal ablations by >=0.02 absolute on intervention-probe slice
Chance-corrected learned Brier gain retained >=95% after eight unrelated laws, without relearning target law on revisit
Identical source/actions and shared exact trained checkpoint; native cold state byte-identical across OS
Whole-process source+actor+learner measured wall ratio <=1.5 against best control on both OS; resource parity measured and disclosed
All negative and paired contrast controls pass; source/private IDs never accessed by learner
stop: Any frozen failed predicate => DEV_NO_GO with negative preserved. No post-result retuning. In-house development cannot establish independent scientific first-use or general intelligence.
